name: ClojureScript Lein-Figwheel Dev
postCreateCommand:
bash -c 'echo "[POST-CREATE] Starting postCreateCommand..." && \
DATOMIC_VERSION="1.0.7482" && \
DATOMIC_JAR="lib/com/datomic/datomic-pro/\${DATOMIC_VERSION}/datomic-pro-\${DATOMIC_VERSION}.jar" && \
if [ ! -f "\${DATOMIC_JAR}" ]; then \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] Datomic Pro JAR not found, downloading..." && \
  mkdir -p "lib/com/datomic/datomic-pro/\${DATOMIC_VERSION}" && \
  curl -L -o /tmp/datomic-pro-\${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip \
    "https://datomic-pro-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com/\${DATOMIC_VERSION}/datomic-pro-\${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip" && \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] Extracting zip..." && \
  unzip -q /tmp/datomic-pro-\${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip -d /tmp/datomic-extract && \
  JAR_FILE=$(find /tmp/datomic-extract -name "datomic-pro-*.jar" -type f | head -1) && \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] Found JAR: \${JAR_FILE}" && \
  cp "\${JAR_FILE}" "\${DATOMIC_JAR}" && \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] Verifying JAR placement..." && \
  ls -lh "\${DATOMIC_JAR}" && \
  rm -rf /tmp/datomic-pro-\${DATOMIC_VERSION}.zip /tmp/datomic-extract && \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] ✅ Datomic Pro installed to lib/ (using file:lib repository)"; \
else \
  echo "[POST-CREATE] ✅ Datomic Pro already in lib/" && \
  ls -lh "\${DATOMIC_JAR}"; \
fi && \
echo "[POST-CREATE] Running lein deps..." && \
lein deps && \
echo "[POST-CREATE] ✅ lein deps completed successfully" && \
echo "[POST-CREATE] Verifying Datomic Pro dependency resolution..." && \
lein classpath | grep -q datomic-pro && echo "[POST-CREATE] ✅ Datomic Pro found in classpath" || echo "[POST-CREATE] ⚠️  Datomic Pro not found in classpath"'
